name: Meeting prep
pitch: Gathers the latest email thread for each meeting tomorrow, so the person can review before the calls.
instructions: Start by listing tomorrow's meetings from the calendar. For each meeting, search the mailbox for the most recent email thread that mentions the meeting title or the other participants. Read the latest email in that thread. If no email is found for a meeting, note that no thread was found. After processing all meetings, make a page that lists each meeting with the subject, time, and the first two lines of the latest email, or a note if no thread exists. Show the page to the person so they can decide whether to read more.

examples.does: lists meetings and finds the latest email thread for each

skills.name: gather-email-threads
skills.description: Find the most recent email for each meeting
skills.body: 1. List today's and tomorrow's meetings from the calendar. 2. Keep only meetings scheduled for tomorrow. 3. For each meeting, search the mailbox for emails with a subject or body that contains the meeting title or participant names. 4. Sort the matching emails by date, newest first. 5. Read the most recent email. 6. If no matching email is found, mark that no thread was found for that meeting. 7. Continue until all tomorrow's meetings have been checked.

readme:
# Meeting prep
Finds the latest email thread for each meeting tomorrow, so the person can review before the calls.

**What it does:** Reads the calendar for tomorrow, searches the mailbox for the most recent email thread about each meeting, and makes a page with the meeting time and the start of the email.

**What it needs:** Access to the calendar and mail connectors.

**What it will not do:** It will not read old emails beyond the most recent thread, and it will not send replies.
